BICLOPS HERO
CR 16

XP 76,800
Biclops fighter 4
N Huge humanoid (giant)
Init +2; Senses low-light vision; Perception +21

DEFENSE

AC 30, touch 9, flat-footed 28 (+8 armor, +2 Dex, +12 natural, -2 size)
hp 275 (17d8+136 plus 4d10+32 plus 4)
Fort +22; Ref +10; Will +10; +1 vs. fear
Defensive Abilities bravery +1, rock catching

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft.
Melee 2 +1 longswords +27/+22/+17/+11 (3d6+13/18–20)
Ranged 2 masterwork spears +16 (3d6+11/x3) or 2 rocks +16 (2d6+15)
Space 15 ft.; Reach 15 ft.
Special Attacks rock throwing (140 ft.), superior two-weapon fighting

STATISTICS

Str 33, Dex 14, Con 26, Int 10, Wis 14, Cha 10
Base Atk +16; CMB +28 (+30 bull rush, overrun); CMD 40 (42 vs. bull rush, overrun)
Feats Awesome Blow, Cleave, Critical Focus, Improved Bull Rush, Improved Critical (longsword)B, Improved Overrun, Intimidating Prowess, Iron Will, Lightning Reflexes, Martial Weapon Proficiency (longsword), Power Attack, Quick Draw, Weapon Focus (longsword)B , Weapon Specialization (longsword)B
Skills Climb +18, Craft (any) +9, Intimidate +32, Perception +21; Racial Modifiers +2 Perception
Languages Common, Giant
SQ armor training 1
Combat Gear 2 potion of cure serious wounds; Other Gear +2 chainmail, 2 +1 longswords, 2 masterwork spears
